summary: NQ and ES kept the trend going and pushed to fresh highs on a quiet tape, while gold and crude went the other way. NQ closed up 0.94% at 31,340 after clearing Friday's 31,282 high and tagging 31,371, and ES ran with it to a 7,848 high and a 7,830 close, with the S&P cash index back in record territory near 7,794. VIX ticked up to 15.52 but stayed low, so this was a calm grind rather than a volatility move. Gold stayed capped below a falling stop and chopped to close 4,168, and crude flipped bearish, lost its stop and closed down 2.20% at 89.26.

risk.note: Week ahead: the shutdown keeps federal data (jobs, CPI) on hold, so expect a thin, headline-driven tape with Fed speakers as the main input. The indices are extended into fresh highs, so respect the chance of a pullback to the rising stops rather than chasing. Crude flipped below its ATR stop today, so size energy off the new short-side read. Gold trades the December contract (MGC2!) after the October roll, size it off that basis.

psychology: When the tape grinds higher on low volatility, the hardest thing to do is let it. The urge to call a top and the urge to chase the breakout bar come from the same place, impatience. Today the trend and the rising stop did the work. Let a pullback toward the rising stop or AVWAP set up your entries, keep size standard, and treat the quiet tape as a reason for patience.
